records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

records.question: 平均折扣最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.chart_reading: 5 项中最高是 Chairs(95),其次 Tables(87),最低 Furnishings(14),最高约为最低的 6.8 倍。按 avg_discount 计,最高是 Binders(0.34)。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       COUNT(*) AS item_rows,
       ROUND(AVG(oi.discount), 4) AS avg_discount,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.discount * oi.sales) / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS sales_weighted_avg_discount
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY avg_discount DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?

records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) / SUM(oi.sales) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct,
       COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL AND oi.profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY SUM(oi.profit) / SUM(oi.sales) DESC

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(sales) AS cnt, ROUND(AVG(sales), 2) AS median_sales
FROM (
  SELECT sales
  FROM order_items
  WHERE sales IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY sales
  LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(sales) FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL) % 2
  OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(sales) - 1) / 2 FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL)
)

records.question: 2014 年按月的利润趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN oi.profit < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_items
FROM order_items oi

WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
